findings.source_quote: The stories of Conrad Grebel, Felix Manz, and George Blaurock are well known to many of us.
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the Russian rendering of "George Blaurock" to a conventional, grammatically appropriate transliteration. For example: «Конрад Гребель, Феликс Манц и Георг Блауэрок» (or «Георг Блаурок» depending on house style). Keep the same case/inflection as the surrounding Russian sentence (nominative here).
findings.translation_quote: Истории о Конраде Гребеле, Феликсе Манце и Георге Блауэроке хорошо известны многим из нас.
